# prompt-listener

> Versioned fork-master template: 5-stage prompt/session analysis + AgentEvent
> v2 provenance schema.
> Last-checked: 2026-08-16 | Version: 1.0.0 | Tests: 14 passed

## Core idea

A FORK-MASTER, not a shared dependency: fork the logic when your purpose
diverges, register the fork in FORKS.md (declared divergence beats silent
copies), the master stays versioned and tested. Import only when the purpose
stays identical.

## Components

- prompt_analyzer.py: JSONL session logs -> extraction -> topic filter -> LLM
  classification (type/topic/purpose/intent/method) -> aggregation ->
  statistics. Stages 0-1 dependency-free (--dry-run); stages 2-4 use an LLM
  runner as an optional, detected neighbour.
- schema/agent_event_v2.py (+ JSON Schema): stdlib-only provenance ledger --
  AgentEvent core + 18 sub-ledgers (source, authority, trust boundary,
  tool/MCP context, memory influence, planned vs executed action, gate
  decision, review status).
- fixture_corpus.py + tests/ (14 tests, synthetic fixtures only).

## Known forks (see FORKS.md)

TOM-lm corpus_extract.py (user-model building) · AI-LAB research working copy
(keeps private corpora/_results).

## Boundaries

Research data (_results/, _sources/) never enters this repo (gitignored).
No network, no API key needed for stages 0-1.
